integrity: The general sufficiency and sharpness statements are proved analytically. The bundled verifier checks the finite graph examples and a concrete sharpness witness but is not a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes uncoupled physical dynamics and fixed sparse observation sets.
The necessity direction is universal at the support level; special nuisance functions can remain invariant despite graph-condition failure.
Only the abstract and bibliographic metadata of the 2024 IEEE feedback-potential paper were available for direct comparison.
title: A sharp reachability criterion for sparse-feedback potential difference games
